title: Visual identities
staged as
digital matter.
hero.description: The work unfolds across WebGL environments, editorial layouts, and mockups that materialize through particle-based assembly.

profile.body: The site behaves like an installation: slow camera travel, cinematic section changes, and premium material studies rather than flat project tiles.

featured.description: Scroll shifts the camera through a three-dimensional sequence of mockups. Each project lives at a different depth plane, while the matching artwork assembles from particles onto the object surface.

about.title: Design systems with editorial calm and a universe-scale point of view.
statements: Shader-led transitions replace hard cuts with atmospheric reveals.
Mockups are treated like lit objects in a gallery, not screenshots in cards.
Typography stays large, patient, and sharply composed across every section.
The Playground expands the portfolio into a laboratory for motion and code.

finalStage.title: Scroll exits the galaxy into the Playground and studio context.
